Title: Applied AI Engineer – LLM & Agentic Systems
Description:
About the Opportunity
AIDA Recruitment is looking for an experienced Applied AI Engineer to join our client's rapidly growing, AI-native technology company in the UK.
Our client is transforming the property management industry by developing an AI-powered platform that automates complex operational processes, integrates traditional businesses, and improves efficiency at scale.
Following a $170 million Series B funding round , the company has raised more than $260 million and now manages over 15,000 properties across the UK.
You will join a growing engineering organization of approximately 20 people, working in small, autonomous teams of 2–3 engineers.
This is an opportunity to become an early core contributor to the company's agentic AI infrastructure, influence architectural decisions, and develop systems already supporting real business operations.
This is not an AI research or traditional Machine Learning position. We are looking for a strong backend software engineer who has built, deployed, and maintained AI agents in production.

Location: Fully Remote – UK & Europe (UK working hours)
Salary: €100,000–€150,000 annually
Contract: Full-time | Permanent or B2B
Equity: Competitive equity options
Tech Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Python, LLMs, Agentic AI
Visa sponsorship: Sponsorship or visa transfers may be possible for candidates already based in London. New international relocation is not offered as standard.
Key Responsibilities
AI Agent Development & Architecture

- Design, build, and maintain production-grade LLM-powered agents and multi-agent systems.
- Develop agentic workflows involving task decomposition, tool calling, structured outputs, orchestration, and feedback loops.
- Build reusable agent components, including memory, context management, and tool integrations.
- Design scalable architectures connecting AI agents with backend services, databases, and business applications.
- Establish architectural patterns that allow new AI workflows to be introduced efficiently.
Evaluation, Reliability & Performance

- Design and implement automated evaluation frameworks for AI agents.
- Create evaluation datasets with measurable success criteria and pass thresholds.
- Integrate agent evaluations into CI/CD pipelines and release processes.
- Monitor and improve agent reliability, latency, accuracy, and operational costs.
- Investigate hallucinations, incorrect tool calls, unexpected outputs, and production failures.
- Develop observability, debugging, error-handling, and fallback mechanisms.
Product Development & Engineering

- Collaborate with product managers, data engineers, and operational teams to identify automation opportunities.
- Transform complex business processes into reliable AI-driven solutions.
- Take ownership of features from architecture and development through deployment and production monitoring.
- Use modern AI coding agents, such as Claude Code or Codex, to improve engineering productivity.
- Contribute to technical decisions, engineering standards, and long-term platform scalability.
Essential Requirements
Software Engineering Background

- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience , with strong backend development expertise.
- Hands-on experience with TypeScript/Node.js , or strong Python backend experience with willingness to work in a TypeScript-first environment.
- Experience designing APIs, integrating databases, and building scalable production applications.
- Strong understanding of software architecture, testing, CI/CD, and production reliability.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
Production AI & Agentic Systems – Mandatory

- Proven experience personally building and deploying LLM-powered agents or agentic systems used by real users in production.
- Hands-on experience with agent orchestration, tool calling, structured outputs, context management, and feedback loops.
- Ability to explain the complete architecture of an AI system you developed, including your individual technical contributions.
- Experience handling real production challenges involving latency, cost, reliability, hallucinations, and failure recovery.
- Practical experience building agent evaluations, including evaluation datasets, measurable success thresholds, and automated testing or release gates.
- Understanding of when to use LLMs, deterministic software, multiple agents, or human intervention.
Professional Background & Mindset

- Recent hands-on engineering experience in an AI-native company, product-led startup, or high-growth technology scale-up is strongly preferred.
- Experience independently owning and delivering production software systems.
- Strong problem-solving abilities and architectural judgment.
- Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
- Excellent English communication skills.
Nice-to-Have Experience

- Developing reusable agent orchestration frameworks or shared AI engineering libraries.
- Building production multi-agent systems with specialized subagents.
- Experience with PostgreSQL and distributed backend architectures.
- Implementing advanced LLM observability and evaluation tools.
- Optimizing LLM inference costs, response latency, and system performance.
- Previous experience in an early-stage, AI-focused product engineering team.
What Kind of Experience Are We Looking For?
We are particularly interested in engineers who can demonstrate ownership of real production AI systems.
A strong candidate should be able to describe:

- A production AI agent: What did you build, what business problem did it solve, and how many users or transactions did it support?
- System architecture: How did you implement agent orchestration, tool integration, context management, and backend services?
- Evaluation: How did you measure agent quality? What evaluation dataset sizes, pass thresholds, or automated release checks did you use?
- Production challenges: What specific failure, hallucination, reliability issue, or latency problem did you encounter, and how did you resolve it?
- AI development practices: How do you use coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex in your daily engineering workflow?
This Position May Not Be Suitable If:

- Your AI experience is limited to calling LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or building simple chatbot wrappers.
- You have built AI prototypes or proof-of-concepts but have not deployed and maintained agents in production.
- Your background is primarily in traditional machine learning, data science, computer vision, or academic AI research.
- Your experience focuses on MLOps or AI infrastructure without hands-on ownership of agentic applications.
- You are primarily a frontend developer without substantial backend engineering experience.
- You have worked mainly on short-term AI consulting projects without responsibility for a production product.
The key requirement is hands-on engineering ownership of reliable, production-grade agentic AI systems.
Technology Stack

- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python
- Backend: Node.js, REST APIs, PostgreSQL
- AI: Large Language Models, Agentic Workflows, Multi-Agent Systems
- AI Engineering: Tool Calling, Structured Outputs, Context Management, Orchestration
- Quality & Infrastructure: Agent Evaluations, Observability, CI/CD, Automated Testing
- Development Tools: Claude Code, Codex, or similar AI coding agents
Why Join?

- Real production AI: Work on agentic systems already supporting business operations rather than experimental AI projects.
- Strong financial backing: Join a fast-growing technology company with over $260 million in funding.
- Architectural ownership: Help establish the core infrastructure, engineering patterns, and technical standards for AI systems.
- Small, autonomous teams: Work directly with experienced engineers, product specialists, and engineering leadership.
- Professional growth: Opportunity to influence product direction, propose new initiatives, and take ownership of technically challenging projects.
- Remote flexibility: Work remotely from eligible UK or European locations.
- Competitive compensation: €100,000–€150,000 annually, with equity opportunities.

Interview Process

- AIDA Recruitment Initial Screening – Initial review of your experience and suitability for the position.
- Recruiter Interview (30 minutes) – Background, relevant experience, expectations, and availability.
- Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes) – Technical ownership, previous projects, and engineering approach.
- System Design Interview (60 minutes) – Agentic architecture, scalability, orchestration, reliability, and evaluation.
- Technical Interview (60 minutes) – Practical software engineering and applied AI capabilities.
- Team Interview (45 minutes) – Collaboration, communication, and product mindset.
- Optional Founder Interview (30 minutes) – Final discussion about company vision and alignment.
The interview process typically takes approximately two weeks, depending on candidate availability.
Interested in Joining?
If you are a backend-oriented software engineer with proven experience building and operating LLM-based agents in production , we would love to hear from you.
Please apply with your updated CV and be prepared to discuss specific examples of AI systems you have developed, their architecture, evaluation methods, and real-world performance.
What happens after you apply?
Our recruitment team will review your application. If your profile matches the key requirements, you will receive an email invitation to complete a more detailed application form, including initial technical screening questions.
Candidates who successfully pass the initial screening will be considered for the next stages of the recruitment process.

Title: Senior AI Application Engineer - LLM & VLM Enablement
Description:
About Us
Axelera AI is not your regular deep-tech company. We are creating the next-generation AI platform to support anyone who wants to help advancing humanity and improve the world around us.
In just five years, we have raised a total of $450 million and have built a world-class team of 250+ employees (including 60+ PhDs with more than 40,000 citations), both remotely from 21 different countries and with offices in Belgium, France, Switzerland, Italy, the UK, headquartered at the High Tech Campus in Eindhoven, Netherlands.
We have also launched our Metis™ AI Platform, which achieves a 3-5x increase in efficiency and performance, and have visibility into a strong business pipeline exceeding $100 million.
Our unwavering commitment to innovation has firmly established us as a global industry pioneer.
Are you up for the challenge?

Position Overview
As a Senior AI Application Engineer in the Model Enablement team (Application Software), you will own LLM and VLM support on Metis and Europa AIPUs, from studying new models to shipping them in the Voyager SDK.
The role combines LLM/VLM knowledge with solid software engineering. Our team uses AI coding agents in daily work, and you will use them to build, test and verify your own work.
We also welcome experienced field application engineers, technical leads and engineering managers who want to return to hands-on engineering. Experience in planning, delegating and reviewing work transfers well to working with AI agents.

Key responsibilities:

- LLM/VLM study: Study new LLM and VLM families and architectures (for example mixture-of-experts, small VLMs, new attention and decoding schemes). Prototype and profile them on Metis and Europa, and decide how they should run on our hardware.

- Productization: Turn your results and our ML research group's results into supported Voyager SDK features, with stable APIs, tests, documentation and release gates.

- Model-side contracts: For each LLM/VLM building block, own the PyTorch reference with quantization baked in, the weight mapping, and one contract that lists every input, output, weight and persistent state (such as a paged KV cache), and hand that contract to the compiler team. The runtime and tests use the same definition.

- Pipeline integration: Bring LLM and VLM serving into the Voyager SDK pipeline builder: prefill and decode, KV-cache management, streaming text output and multimodal inputs.

- Quality: With the regression and quantization owners, measure accuracy against the floating-point reference, and close or explain each gap.

- LLM/VLM bring-up platform: Extend the model enablement platform for LLM and VLM bring-up: environments with access to the compiler, runtime and real hardware (for example through MCP tools), closed-loop runs that apply a change, measure accuracy and speed against the reference and repeat, and evaluations that score each run.

- GenAI direction: Recommend what the Voyager SDK needs for GenAI, agents and speech on edge devices, and which model zoo demos show it best.

Qualifications:
Essential

- 5+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years on ML inference, ML systems or ML tooling.

- Solid understanding of transformer inference: attention variants, KV caching, prefill versus decode, sampling, tokenization, and how a VLM joins a vision encoder to a language model.

- Working knowledge of LLM quantization (weight-only and weight-activation schemes, calibration, outlier handling), and the ability to tell a quantization loss from an implementation bug.

- Strong Python and PyTorch, and experience shipping production-quality software.

- Daily use of AI coding agents on real codebases, with good judgment about when to verify or reject their output.

- Ability to turn research code and hardware constraints into a practical design.

Preferred

- Experience with inference engines or serving stacks (for example llama.cpp, vLLM, ONNX Runtime GenAI, ExecuTorch).

- Experience with kernel development or a tensor compiler (for example Triton, TVM or MLIR), or with profiling models on accelerator hardware.

- Experience with speech (ASR, TTS) or agentic applications on embedded devices.

- Experience building evaluation or testing harnesses for ML systems or AI agents, or tool-calling agents (for example MCP servers).

Location
We offer a flexible working arrangement, with options to:

- Work from one of our Axelera AI offices (Leuven in Belgium, Amsterdam and Eindhoven in the Netherlands, Zurich in Switzerland, Florence and Milan in Italy or Bristol in the United Kingdom) if you're already based in the vicinity.

- Work fully remotely from any European country (incl. the UK) you are already in.

- Relocate with us and work from Italy (Florence or Milan) or the Netherlands (Amsterdam or Eindhoven).

Kindly note that priority will be given to candidates who are [interested in being] based in Belgium or Italy.

What we offer
This is your chance to shape and be part of a dynamic, fast-growing, international organization. We offer an attractive compensation package, including a pension plan, extensive employee insurances and the option to get company shares.
An open culture that supports creativity and continual innovation is awaiting you. Collaborative ownership and freedom with responsibility is characteristic for the way we act and work as a team.
At Axelera AI, we wholeheartedly embrace equal opportunity and hold diversity in the highest regard. Our steadfast commitment is to cultivate a warm and inclusive environment that empowers and celebrates every member of our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join us in shaping the future of AI.

Think like a builder, not just a relationship manager, you want to get inside the product and understand how it actually works.

Are exceptional at running tight processes: structuring ambiguous problems, mapping workflows step by step, and driving a deployment to a clean finish.

Are energized by working directly with AI products and solving ambiguous customer problems with technology.

Have a strong instinct for where AI can drive ROI in complex operational workflows.

Description:
Senior, Forward Deployed / Full Stack Engineer (Document Authoring & Knowledge Systems )

About GSK Enterprise AI
Enterprise AI is GSK’s centre of gravity for applied artificial intelligence. We pair forward deployed engineers and full-stack engineers with scientific, clinical, and business teams to build AI products that get used — not pilots that get archived. We work fast, ship in production, and measure ourselves on outcomes that matter to patients.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team — we welcome candidates from all backgrounds and underrepresented groups in technology, science, and pharma.

Position Summary
GSK’s Enterprise AI team builds AI solutions that prove value fast and scale to production. The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is the engineer GSK sends in to find out whether an AI idea will work — embedded with business unit (BU) teams, proving ideas through proofs of concept (PoCs), proofs of value (PoVs), and minimum viable products (MVPs) at a days-to-weeks cadence, then handing the proven solution off to the Sr. Solutions Engineer for scale-up. The pattern is proven by AI-native companies — Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI — and this role brings that model to GSK.

This specific role sites in the Chemical Manufacturing & Control (CMC) area. This is the GSK function that turns a validated molecule into a reliably manufactured, quality-assured medicine; its mission is to get safe, effective, consistently manufactured medicines to patients, faster. Its current mission is to double New Product Introductions (NPIs).

Title: Lead Data Scientist
Description:
Lead Data Scientist, Obsero
UK, remote, full time. £80,000 to £100,000 plus equity.
Find out why AI recommends one brand over another. Turn our AI search data into the GEO playbook, the recommendation engine and the models that tell customers what to do next.
About Obsero
Obsero is one of the UK's leading AI search startups. We track how brands are cited and recommended across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Mode and Claude, so marketing teams can see where they stand in AI answers and what to do about it.
The problem
Every day our platform runs thousands of prompts across the major AI platforms and records what comes back: which brands get mentioned, which sources get cited, how they are described and how that changes over time. It is now one of the richest datasets on AI search anywhere. Today the platform tells customers where they stand. The question every marketer actually wants answered is why an LLM recommends one brand over another, and what they should do about it. Your job is to answer it, and to take the platform from insight to action.
Why join now

- We've just raised $1.2m, led by SFC Capital, to build specialist AI agents trained on the GEO playbook from a year of client work
- In our first year we captured and analysed over 10 million AI answers, and that number is growing fast
- You'll be the first data scientist, so you'll set how we turn that data into insight
- Meaningful equity, alongside a salary of £80,000 to £100,000
The role
This is a lead role reporting to a founder. You will own the problem end to end, from a clean, trusted dataset through to models running in the product. Our lead data engineer owns how the data is captured, cleaned and stored, so your time goes on what it means rather than on fixing it.
What you'll own

- The GEO playbook: using our historic prompt data to understand what drives LLMs to recommend one brand over another, separating the factors that genuinely move visibility from the ones that only look like they do
- The recommendation engine: productising Obsero's GEO recommendation engine in the platform, and measuring whether recommendations work so results feed back into the engine
- Predictive models: predicting the likely impact of different actions for each customer, so they know what to do first
- New insight: exploring new ways to analyse the data, prototyping quickly and turning the best ideas into features
This is not a reporting or dashboarding role. We want someone who asks better questions of the data than we do, and builds the models and products that answer them.
What you'll need

- Several years of hands-on data science, with a track record of taking models from analysis into production
- Strong Python and SQL, comfortable building the analysis and feature pipelines your models need
- Statistical modelling, causal inference or experimentation, and the judgement to tell correlation from cause in messy, real-world data
- Experience with recommendation systems, ranking or predictive modelling
- Hands-on with LLMs and NLP, and properly curious about how AI platforms decide what to recommend
- The ability to explain complex findings clearly to marketers, consultants and founders
- Product-minded, focused on what will change a customer's results
- Comfortable owning a problem end to end in a small team
Nice to have

- An understanding of SEO or GEO
You'll need to be based in the UK with the right to work here.
What success looks like

- A GEO playbook grounded in evidence that our consultants and customers use
- A recommendation engine live in the platform, with customers acting on what it tells them
- Measurable improvement in customer visibility from the actions it prioritises
- Insight that sets Obsero apart from every other AI search tool
How we hire
Intro call with the Chief Product Officer, a technical conversation with our lead engineer, a presentation and then meeting the CEO.
How to apply
Apply through the link on this ad. Tell us briefly about a model you took from idea to production, and what difference it made.

Title: Data Scientist

Data Scientist - Hybrid Working - London/Home
What you'll do
As a Data Scientist and member of our Data Science team, you will play a pivotal role in developing in-house data science solutions that automate decision-making and provide valuable insights across our business. You will deliver high-quality analyses that guide future development work and contribute to the team's continuous learning and upskilling efforts.

Why join us

- Wide impact. Deploying models here means improving the experience of millions of customers each day.
- Range of projects. Our projects vary from supply chain optimisation for one of the largest logistics networks in the country, predicting which substitution products online shoppers prefer, to helping our instore colleagues keep shelves full.

- Learning and mentoring. With a team of 50 data scientists, engineers and product managers, there are lots of opportunities to learn from colleagues through knowledge shares, pair programming, and communities of practice.

- Save on groceries . 10% discount on products across Sainsburys (Up to 15% for two days each week!)

What you need to excel in this role:
Essential Criteria

- Educated to degree level, preferably within a mathematical, statistical or STEM discipline.
- A solid track record of individually contributing to value-driving data science projects in a commercial setting.

- Strong presentation skills and business acumen, you regularly receive positive feedback about your ability to explain complex topics to non-technical audiences.

- Experience getting the best out of sklearn and tree-based models.
- Highly proficient in Git best practices.
- Experience working in cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).

Desirable

- A relevant Post-graduate degree (Masters or PhD) within a mathematical, statistical or other STEM discipline.
- Experience building or maintaining machine learning pipelines and endpoints in Azure ML.
- Experience delivering value on ML projects in retail (in areas such as price elasticity or differential pricing) or supply chain (demand forecasting, optimisation etc.).
- Experience going from unstructured business problems through to well defined Data science solutions
- Our products often utilize mathematical optimisation, so experience in this area is highly desirable.
- Experience in applying causal frameworks to data science solutions and applying causal inference methods.
- Experience working with and deploying Graphical Neural Networks [GNNs] in industry.
- Experience with other more complex models and frameworks.
- Experience working within in a cross functional team.

At Sainsbury’s, data sits at the heart of how we operate, innovate and serve our customers. Title: Agentic AI Engineer – Java/Kotlin
Description:
Agentic AI Engineer – Java/Kotlin
Reading, Berkshire | Hybrid – 1 day per week in the office | Up to £115,000
We're working with a major UK organisation investing significantly in AI and modern engineering, and we're looking for an experienced Agentic AI Engineer to join a highly capable technology function.

This isn't simply an LLM integration role. You'll work at the intersection of Agentic AI, Software Engineering, Architecture and Data, partnering directly with business stakeholders to identify complex operational problems and build agentic solutions that deliver genuine business value.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, can move comfortably from discovery and rapid prototyping into robust software engineering, and wants to help shape how Agentic AI is applied within a large-scale organisation.

What you'll be doing

- Work directly with business stakeholders to understand complex and sometimes poorly defined operational challenges.
- Identify opportunities where Agentic AI and automation can materially improve existing business processes.
- Design, prototype and implement agentic systems, rapidly iterating solutions in collaboration with end users.
- Apply systems thinking and data analysis to identify root causes, friction points and opportunities for improvement.
- Use strong software engineering and architecture principles to take ideas beyond proof-of-concept.
- Explore short-term solutions capable of delivering immediate business value while considering longer-term scalability.
- Help shape technical architecture and product roadmaps based on insights gained from real-world business problems.
- Communicate complex technical ideas clearly and influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What we're looking for

You'll need strong hands-on software engineering credentials combined with genuine experience building agentic systems.
Essential experience

- Strong commercial software engineering experience within complex environments.
- Proven hands-on development experience with Java and/or Kotlin, particularly building reliable backend services or modern applications.
- Practical experience of Agentic Engineering, including agentic coding environments and automated engineering workflows.
- Experience building and implementing agentic systems using agent orchestration and frameworks.
- Advanced prompt and context engineering experience.
- Understanding of state and memory management within agentic architectures.
- Experience implementing deterministic guardrails and evaluations (Evals).
- Experience integrating agents with external tools and APIs.
- Knowledge of emerging agentic protocols, including MCP, A2A and UCP.
- Experience working with cloud-based data platforms. Snowflake experience would be particularly relevant.
- Experience deploying and operating solutions within cloud environments. GCP exposure would be advantageous.
- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate raw data into meaningful and actionable insights.
- Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the confidence to question assumptions and work with stakeholders to identify the root cause of problems.

Desirable experience

- Data science experience, particularly using data to identify meaningful patterns and actionable insights.
- Experience applying systems-thinking techniques to complex and dynamic business problems.

The opportunity

This is a strong opportunity for an engineer who wants to operate beyond conventional AI development.

You'll have scope to combine hands-on Java/Kotlin engineering with Agentic AI, architecture, experimentation and business problem-solving, focusing on practical use cases and tangible outcomes rather than AI in isolation.
You'll be joining a substantial technology environment where modern engineering, cloud, data and AI are central to solving complex business challenges.

Location & package
Salary: Up to £115,000, depending on experience
Location:Reading, Berkshire
Working pattern:Hybrid – 1 day per week in the Reading office
Interested?
If you're an experienced software engineer with genuine hands-on experience building Agentic AI systems, particularly alongside a strong Java/Kotlin engineering background, we'd be keen to hear from you.
Apply now or get in touch for a confidential discussion about the opportunity.
